name: Delamain
description: Delamain is a self-hosted voice companion for the drive, modeled on Delamain from Cyberpunk 2077. Open it in any browser, including the one on your car's Android Auto display, press the mic and talk. It answers in a cloned Delamain voice (F5-TTS), searches the web through SearXNG, reads you spoken news bulletins, keeps notes, reminders and long-term memory in your Obsidian vault, and hands navigation to your phone's map app. A corrupted personality core with stutters and a glitched voice can be switched on in Settings. Works with any OpenAI-compatible LLM that supports tool calling (llama.cpp, vLLM, Halogen). F5-TTS model weights and a voice reference clip must be supplied by the user (see GitHub).

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and voice clips. Place your 10-second voice reference clip here as delamain_ref_10s.wav.

paths.name: F5-TTS Model Weights
paths.description: Path to F5-TTS model weights directory. Must contain F5TTS_Base/model_1200000.pt and F5TTS_Base/vocab.txt. Download with: huggingface-cli download SWivid/F5-TTS F5TTS_Base/model_1200000.pt F5TTS_Base/vocab.txt --local-dir /path/to/checkpoints

paths.name: Obsidian Vault (optional)
paths.description: Optional: your Obsidian vault. Delamain keeps notes, reminders and long-term memory under Delamain/ in it. Leave blank to keep them inside the container.

ports.name: Backend API Port
ports.description: Web UI, API and WebSocket port.

variables.name: LLM URL
variables.description: Chat completions URL of your OpenAI-compatible LLM server (llama.cpp, vLLM, Halogen). Use the server's LAN IP — not localhost (that resolves inside the container).

variables.name: LLM Model
variables.description: Model id your LLM server serves (listed at its /v1/models). llama.cpp ignores it.

variables.name: LLM Reasoning Effort
variables.description: For reasoning models (Qwen, Halogen): set to none to turn thinking off so replies come quickly. Leave blank for other models.

variables.name: Tools
variables.description: Let the LLM call tools: web search, news, Obsidian notes and memory. Needs a model with tool calling.

variables.name: SearXNG URL
variables.description: Optional: URL of a SearXNG instance for live web search (weather, traffic, places) and the news fallback. Example: http://192.168.1.x:8887/search

variables.name: Allowed Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to connect to the backend. Include your domain if accessing over the internet. Example: https://delamain.example.com,http://192.168.1.x:8888

variables.name: NVIDIA GPU (optional)
variables.description: Set to 'all' to enable NVIDIA GPU passthrough for F5-TTS acceleration. Requires Nvidia-Driver plugin installed in Unraid. Leave blank for CPU-only.
